t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Meɖi ɖase, O nye Mawu, be Ewɔm be manya Wò eye masubɔ wò. Meɖi ɖase le ɣeyiɣi sia me le nye ŋusẽmanɔŋu kple Wó gãnyenye ŋuti, le nye hĩa kple wò kesinɔnuwo ŋuti. Mawua ɖeki megali wu Wò o, Kpeɖeŋutɔ le Xaxame. Amesi le agbe le edokui si.
